name: @shift/landing
//: AD-28 (story 21.21): Smjenko's public page. One hand-written Croatian HTML page, a 404 page and one stylesheet, with no framework and no client script, built by `build.ts` (Node, no dependency) into `dist` and served by the `shift-landing` image (`deploy/landing`). Its one dependency is the app's own font, copied byte-identical. `check/` is the Chromium check CI runs against the running image (axe-core and Playwright from the root).
